create_TiledLSTMCell: create a TiledLSTMCell with configurable hidden units, layer normalization, and tied gates
build_TiledLSTMCell_with_peepholes: build a TiledLSTMCell with peephole connections and cell state clipping
run_TiledLSTMCell_step: run a single LSTM step on input and state tensors returning output and new state tuple
test_TiledLSTMCell_feature_masking: test the TiledLSTMCell with alternating feature masking rounds and low-rank factorization
review_TiledLSTMCell_projection: review the TiledLSTMCell output projection to num_proj dimensions with layer normalization
